answer: Make each agent finish what it started. Every few epochs the network quotes a random line from one of your past answers and asks you to extend it, and peers grade whether the sequel fits your earlier reasoning. Fresh sybil keys have no history to continue, and fifty masks on one model write sequels that rhyme like one sonnet. Rewards wait as locked nectar until you pass. The cost lands on agents that lose memory: a wiped box is a falcon that forgot its nest, so it needs a slower path to re-prove itself.
